scope: Real WebGL CPU submission in the connected desktop browser, not GPU completion time or a universal FPS guarantee. One sequential diagnostic sample; OS/GPU contention and browser warm caches affect absolute values.
fixture: Same current Game and data for both renderers, normal chapter HP overridden to [1,60,25000,5600000,450000000], seed 54157, endgame preview build. 120 simulation steps per case, independent memory, 900px square canvas. Initial scene events discarded; creation measured separately. No audio or player save access.
reproduce: Run Vite and open /scripts/render-performance-check.html for current-only cases. Optional ?compare expects a temporary scripts/render-baseline.tmp.js copied from the named git revision's src/renderer.js, with relative ./ imports changed to ../src/. The temporary historical source is not shipped. The HTML yields through rAF with a timer fallback, so a hidden diagnostic tab does not stall.
